newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to speed up sales tax refund to exporters.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to speed up sales tax refund to exporters.

text.p: Pakistani Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz has promised to refund sales tax to exporters in full within 30 days, revising a policy he announced in last week's budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), the English-language Business Recorder reported on Friday.
The Karachi-based daily quoted Aziz as saying the procedure was being revised at the request of exporters.
The budget had said exporters would get half of the sales tax refund within 30 days and the rest within 90 days, subject to verification and audit.
Exporters had complained that any delay in sales tax refunds would cause acute liquidity problems.
A foreign economist, who asked not to be named, described the original budget policy as "highly ill-advised", saying it would increase the working capital requirements of exporters.
Aziz was expected to announce the revised procedure in the National Assembly (lower house) later on Friday.
